candidates.effect_text: With competence 32.00%: investments would gain about 8.00% more.

With competence 81.00%: investments would gain about 20.25% more.
With competence 74.00%: investments would gain about 18.50% more.

cabinet_posts.post_effect_text: Makes relationship investments more effective: a fully competent chief of staff adds up to 25.00% to each investment's gain. A new appointee starts to count from the next turn.

candidates.effect_text: With competence 32.00%: a counterpart would grant up to 1.92 percentage points more of its remaining pool.
With competence 86.00%: a counterpart would grant up to 5.16 percentage points more of its remaining pool.
With competence 81.00%: a counterpart would grant up to 4.86 percentage points more of its remaining pool.
With competence 74.00%: a counterpart would grant up to 4.44 percentage points more of its remaining pool.

cabinet_posts.post_effect_text: Improves the terms of foreign assistance: a fully competent foreign minister adds up to 6.00 percentage points to the share of its remaining pool a counterpart grants. A new appointee starts to count from the next turn.
